report.answer: Fail-once-then-succeed HTTP backoff is MASKED_DEFECT with verbatim first-attempt error 'DeterministicConnectError: ECONNRESET on first handshake (deterministic)'. Vendor 429 with Retry-After classifies TRANSIENT. Zero-retry subprocess.run sites are excluded. Live runner: dispatch_cursor INFRA (predicate:absent / runtime<45) re-queues without strike telemetry (UNOBSERVABLE). Catalog retry_policy is unbound prose (2007 units carry the field). B08 pytest/B08.log absent; B09 logs absent. SUCCESS:BLD-0025

catalog_retry_policy.bld0025_retry_policy: Self-referential caution: this unit must not retry its own instrumentation run silently - a failed instrumentation pass is reported, not retried into a pass.

class_samples.mechanically-different-probe: two strikes then pivot (AGENTS.md 4b): after the SECOND failure on the same hypothesis, enumerate >=2 mechanically different attack vectors before any third attempt; consecutive FAILED on the same error fingerprint is the trigger
class_samples.no-automatic-retry: NO automatic retry: this unit performs a destructive, state-changing or owner-gated drill. On failure STOP, preserve the partial artifact and the restore point, and report BLOCKED with the exact missing prerequisite
class_samples.other: one retry only when the failure classifies as environment-transient (codex arg-limit, severed stream, runner eviction); on win-arg-limit retry ONCE with --ignore-user-config and a prompt file. A logic or evidence failure is never retried, i
class_samples.self-no-silent-retry: Self-referential caution: this unit must not retry its own instrumentation run silently - a failed instrumentation pass is reported, not retried into a pass.
class_samples.staggered-vendor-429: up to 3 attempts with staggered arrival (60s / 300s / 900s) because this unit depends on external endpoints; a 429/529 is provider-side and is NOT a unit failure and must NOT reduce concurrency
class_samples.two-strikes-pivot: two strikes then pivot: after the second graph-construction failure with the same fingerprint, switch to a different extraction strategy (dynamic tracing rather than static graph, or the reverse) before a third attempt

report.question: Where does a retry policy hide a deterministic defect? Instrument every retrying call site — per-unit retry_policy, HTTP backoff wrappers, flaky-test reruns, monitor re-polls, cache refresh loops — to record attempt counts and first-attempt errors, then report every operation that succeeded only on attempt two or later. An operation that always fails once and then passes is a defect, not flakiness.
